scanNote:
10-UNITNING BIRINChI BETI (70-bet) - LEAD-IN. Fon: oq villa, basseyn va favvora sur'ati; o'ngda qora shlyapali chaqaloq.

Chap yuqorida oq 'UNIT 10', SARIQ bo'rtma harflar 'Stick to the Rules!'.

YETTI SURAT yorliqli: A hot water (qaynoq suv), B swimming pool (basseyn), C stairs (zina), D electrical sockets (rozetka), E knife (pichoq), F matches (gugurt), G cleaning products (tozalash vositalari - sprey shisha).

CHAP USTUN:
• To'q sariq 'Lead-in'.
1) 'The pictures show causes of accidents that children might have at home. Match them to the results in the list, then make sentences, as in the examples.' 'Results' (katakchali): fall and hurt themselves; drink them and poison themselves; get an electric shock; burn themselves; scald themselves; cut themselves; fall in and drown. Ko'k qiya namunalar: "Don't let children play near stairs. They MIGHT fall and hurt themselves." / 'Never let children play with cleaning products. They COULD drink them and poison themselves.'
2) Kasseta belgisi: 'Read the statements, then listen and complete the missing words.' 1 K _ _ _ all cleaning products in a safe place. 2 P _ _ knives away after use. 3 Never a _ _ _ _ _ your children to play with pots and pans on the stove. 4 Make sure you c _ _ _ _ electrical sockets when they are not in use. 5 Never l _ _ your children play with matches. 6 F _ _ safety gates at the top and bottom of the stairs. 7 P _ _ a fence around any ponds or pools in your garden.

O'NG USTUN:
• Katta to'q sariq 'Reading'.
3) a) 'Read the leaflet, then circle the correct answers to these questions.' (varaqa 71-betda) 1 Who is the leaflet for? a Parents with young children b New home owners. 2 What does the leaflet give advice about? a Keeping your home clean b Preventing accidents. 3 What does the leaflet advise readers to do? a Make sure children don't play with dangerous objects. b Teach children to follow rules about safety.
   b) 'Use the information in the leaflet to ask and answer questions in pairs, as in the example.' Ko'k qiya: SA: Why should we keep all cleaning products in a safe place? SB: Because children might drink them and poison themselves.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '70'.

exercises.instructionEn: The pictures show causes of accidents that children might have at home. Match them to the results in the list.
exercises.instructionUz: Suratlar bolalar uyda duch kelishi mumkin bo'lgan baxtsiz hodisalar sabablarini ko'rsatadi. Ularni ro'yxatdagi natijalarga moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
SABAB → NATIJA.

  A hot water → scald themselves
  B swimming pool → fall in and
     drown
  C stairs → fall and hurt themselves
  D electrical sockets → get an
     electric shock
  E knife → cut themselves
  F matches → burn themselves
  G cleaning products → drink them
     and poison themselves


⚠ 'THEMSELVES':

  = o'zlarini (o'zlik olmoshi,
  ko'plik).
  ⚠ 10-unit mavzusi - 71-betda.


⚠ 'TO SCALD' va 'TO BURN':

  scald = qaynoq SUV/BUG' bilan
     kuydirmoq
  burn = OLOV/issiq narsa bilan
     kuydirmoq


⚠ 'TO POISON':

  = zaharlamoq.
  ⚠ 'poison' (ot) = zahar;
  'poisonous' = zaharli (68-bet).


⚠ 'AN ELECTRIC SHOCK':

  = tok urishi.
  ⚠ 'to get an electric shock' =
  tok urmoq.


⚠ 'A CAUSE' va 'A RESULT':

  cause = sabab; result = natija.


⚠ 'TO STICK TO THE RULES':

  = qoidalarga rioya qilmoq
  (unit nomi).

pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Kitobdagi namuna: 'play near stairs ... fall
and hurt themselves'.

⚠ Kitobdagi namuna: 'cleaning products ...
drink them and poison themselves'.

exercises.instructionEn: Then make sentences, as in the examples.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNALAR:

  "Don't let children play near
   stairs. They MIGHT fall and hurt
   themselves."
  'Never let children play with
   cleaning products. They COULD
   drink them and poison themselves.'


⚠ QOLIP:

  Don't let / Never let children +
  fe'l ... They might/could + natija.


⚠ 'MIGHT' va 'COULD':

  Ikkalasi = ... bo'lishi MUMKIN
  (ehtimol).
  ⚠ 'might' - ehtimol ozroq;
  'could' - imkoniyat bor.
  ⚠ 10-unit grammatikasi.


⚠ 'TO LET SB DO':

  = kimgadir ruxsat bermoq.
  ⚠ 'let' dan keyin 'to' SIZ fe'l:
  "Don't let children PLAY".
exercises.exampleEn: Don't let children play near stairs. They might fall and hurt themselves.
exercises.exampleUz: Bolalarni zina yonida o'ynashga qo'ymang. Ular yiqilib jarohatlanishi mumkin.
modelAnswers: Don't let children play near stairs. They might fall and hurt themselves.
Never let children play with cleaning products. They could drink them and poison themselves.
Don't let children play near electrical sockets. They might get an electric shock.
Never let children play with matches. They could burn themselves.
Don't let children play near hot water. They might scald themselves.
Never let children play with knives. They could cut themselves.
Don't let children play near the swimming pool. They might fall in and drown.
modelAnswersUz: Bolalarni zina yonida o'ynashga qo'ymang. Ular yiqilib jarohatlanishi mumkin.
Bolalarni hech qachon tozalash vositalari bilan o'ynashga qo'ymang. Ular ichib zaharlanishi mumkin.
Bolalarni rozetka yonida o'ynashga qo'ymang. Ularni tok urishi mumkin.
Bolalarni hech qachon gugurt bilan o'ynashga qo'ymang. Ular o'zini kuydirib olishi mumkin.
Bolalarni qaynoq suv yonida o'ynashga qo'ymang. Ular o'zini kuydirib olishi mumkin.
Bolalarni hech qachon pichoq bilan o'ynashga qo'ymang. Ular o'zini kesib olishi mumkin.
Bolalarni basseyn yonida o'ynashga qo'ymang. Ular tushib ketib cho'kishi mumkin.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the statements, then listen and complete the missing words.
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni o'qing, so'ng tinglang va tushib qolgan so'zlarni to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ Audio bor, lekin javoblar 71-BETDAGI
VARAQADA va harflar soni ko'rsatilgan.


JAVOBLAR:

  1 KEEP all cleaning products in a
    safe place.
  2 PUT knives away after use.
  3 Never ALLOW your children to play
    with pots and pans on the stove.
  4 Make sure you COVER electrical
    sockets when they are not in
    use.
  5 Never LET your children play with
    matches.
  6 FIT safety gates at the top and
    bottom of the stairs.
  7 PUT a fence around any ponds or
    pools in your garden.


⚠ HAMMASI BUYRUQ MAYLIDA (imperative)
  - 10-unit grammatikasi.


⚠ 'ALLOW' va 'LET':

  allow sb TO do - 'to' BILAN
  let sb do - 'to' SIZ
  ⚠ 'Never allow your children TO
  play' / 'Never let your children
  play'.


⚠ 'TO PUT AWAY':

  = joyiga qo'ymoq, yig'ishtirmoq.


⚠ 'TO FIT':

  = o'rnatmoq (mos qilib).
  ⚠ 'a safety gate' = xavfsizlik
  to'sig'i (zina uchun).


⚠ 'NOT IN USE':

  = ishlatilmayotgan.


⚠ 'A POND':

  = hovuz (kichik, tabiiy).
  ⚠ 'a pool' = basseyn.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the leaflet, then circle the correct answers to these questions.
exercises.instructionUz: Varaqani o'qing, so'ng savollarga to'g'ri javoblarni aylantiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ VARAQA 71-BETDA ('Is Your Home A
  Safe Place For Your Kids?').


JAVOBLAR:

  1 a - 'your children', 'your kids'
    → yosh bolali ota-onalar
  2 b - 'accidents that could be
    prevented' → baxtsiz hodisalarni
    oldini olish
  3 a - hamma maslahat XAVFLI
    NARSALARdan uzoq tutish haqida
    (keep, put away, cover, fit,
    fence)


⚠ 'A LEAFLET':

  = varaqa (43-betda ham bor edi).


⚠ 'TO PREVENT':

  = oldini olmoq.
  ⚠ 'prevention' = profilaktika.


⚠ 'TO ADVISE':

  = maslahat bermoq (fe'l - 's').
  ⚠ 'advice' (ot - 'c').


⚠ 'KIDS':

  = bolalar (so'zlashuv).

items.textEn: 2 What does the leaflet give advice about?
3 What does the leaflet advise readers to do?
items.uz: Varaqa o'quvchilarga nima qilishni maslahat beradi?
options: Make sure children don't play with dangerous objects.
Teach children to follow rules about safety.
items.answer: Make sure children don't play with dangerous objects.
items.whyUz:
⚠ Hamma maslahat xavfli narsalarni bolalardan
uzoq tutish haqida (keep, put away, cover...).

exercises.instructionEn: Use the information in the leaflet to ask and answer questions in pairs, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Varaqadagi ma'lumotdan foydalanib juftlikda savol-javob qiling, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:

  SA: Why should we keep all cleaning
      products in a safe place?
  SB: Because children might drink
      them and poison themselves.


⚠ QOLIP:

  Why should we [maslahat]?
  Because children might/could
  [natija].


⚠ 'SHOULD' - MASLAHAT (43-bet).

items.question: SA: Why should we keep all cleaning products in a safe place?
items.answer: SB: Because children might drink them and poison themselves.

items.question: SA: Why should we put knives and other sharp objects away after use?
items.answer: SB: Because children could cut themselves.

items.question: SA: Why should we never allow children to play with pots and pans on the stove?
items.answer: SB: Because they could scald themselves.

items.question: SA: Why should we cover electrical sockets when they are not in use?
items.answer: SB: Because children could give themselves an electric shock.

items.question: SA: Why should we never let children play with matches?
items.answer: SB: Because they might start a fire and burn themselves.

items.question: SA: Why should we fit safety gates at the top and bottom of the stairs?
items.answer: SB: Because children could fall and hurt themselves.

items.question: SA: Why should we put a fence around any ponds or pools in the garden?
items.answer: SB: Because children might fall in and drown.

patterns.formula: Don't let / Never let children + FE'L. They might/could + FE'L.
patterns.exampleEn: Never let children play with matches. They could burn themselves.
patterns.exampleUz: Bolalarni hech qachon gugurt bilan o'ynashga qo'ymang. Ular o'zini kuydirib olishi mumkin.

patterns.formula: Why should we [maslahat]? - Because children might [natija].
patterns.exampleEn: Why should we keep cleaning products in a safe place? - Because children might drink them.
patterns.exampleUz: Nega tozalash vositalarini xavfsiz joyda saqlashimiz kerak? - Chunki bolalar ichib qo'yishi mumkin.

patterns.exampleEn: Make sure you cover electrical sockets when they are not in use.
patterns.exampleUz: Rozetkalar ishlatilmayotganda ularni yopganingizga ishonch hosil qiling.
